note: Levers that lower the cash need, on top of the loaded plan. The Cash levers page applies them in this order and shows what each one takes off. Prudence settings (prepayment reserve, 25% buffer) are deliberately not levers; neither are costs Plus International already carries in kind.

levers.label: Partner rates from Plus International and its partner hospital
levers.detail: Measurement day $850 (from $1,000), physicians $100 an hour (from $120), clinical lead at half cost, hotel discount 20% (from 10%), ongoing legal $18k (from $30k), clinical set-up $10k (from $20k), pilot-year dietitians and coaches from the hospital on demand. Paid in shares (0% revenue share).

levers.label: Physician network in
levers.detail: Referring physicians in the US and target countries: 60% of new clients by referral (plan 15% → 35%), lead to deposit 3.8% (plan 2.7%). Paid in shares.

levers.label: Paid in full at the first visit
levers.detail: The rest of the price after the deposit is paid at the first visit, as at the benchmark business (98% of online payments on the operation day), instead of a share before each visit.

levers.label: Founding-cohort discount 5%
levers.detail: Instead of 15%. The pilot cohort keeps a smaller discount; feedback and case data are still asked for.

levers.label: ATRON platform fee waived in the pilot year
levers.detail: The $3k/month base fee is not charged in year 1 and the $40k set-up balance due in month 13 is converted to equity. Per-client platform cost is unchanged.
